Simplify your salon operations with TVFM POS, an integrated salon management solution designed to streamline your day-to-day business activities. From appointment scheduling and seamless billing to smart inventory management and comprehensive customer management, TVFM POS brings all your essential business functions together on one user-friendly platform.

Manage your staff, monitor business performance, track sales, maintain customer records, and gain better control over your salon operations with ease. By automating routine tasks and providing valuable business insights, TVFM POS helps you save time, improve operational efficiency, enhance customer experiences, and focus on what matters most – growing your business.

items.title: What this website collects
items.body: This website does not ask you to create an account and does not run advertising or analytics trackers. Forms are sent only when you press the send button.

items.title: Salon POS registration
items.body: The registration form on the POS page asks for your name, salon name, mobile number, email address, city, number of branches and any requirements you add. When you submit it, the details are emailed to our team so we can contact you about Salon POS, and we use them for that purpose only.

items.title: When you send an enquiry
items.body: When you send the contact form, we receive your name, email address, phone number, the enquiry type and your message, by email. We use these only to reply to you and to follow up on what you asked about.

items.title: Third-party content
items.body: Some pictures on this website may be delivered by an outside image service. When your browser loads them, that service can see standard connection details such as your IP address and browser type, as with any image on the web.

items.title: Your choices
items.body: You can ask us what we hold about you, ask us to correct it, or ask us to delete it. Write to us at the address below and we will respond.
